title: Dynamics of Coral-Macroalgae Interactions under Crowding
summary: We study a planar ODE model for the benthic competition between coral, macroalgae, and algal turf on a reef, extending the classical model of Mumby, Hastings, and Edwards by a nonlinear, density-dependent coral mortality that accounts for crowding. The strength of crowding is set by an exponent $δ>0$ that reshapes the coral nullcline and enriches the bifurcation structure of the system.
